clockInHint: Starting early? Clock in whenever — we record what happened, not what was planned.
clockInHintNoShift: Nothing's scheduled today — clock in whenever you start.
clockOutSheetHint: Add a break if you took one.
stillOnTheClockBody: This shift has run past its scheduled finish. Clock out and check the times — these are the hours you'll be paid for.
overdueClockOutHint: We've filled in your scheduled finish — change it if you left at a different time.
zeroLengthFinishError: Finish time must be after start time.
zeroLengthRunningError: You've only just clocked in. Close this and choose "I didn't mean to clock in" if it was a mistake.
futureFinishError: Finish time can't be in the future.
tooLongFinishError: That works out as a {{total}} shift. A finish earlier in the day than the start is read as finishing the next day — one shift can't be longer than {{maxHours}} hours.
editEntryHint: Change the times or the break — your household sees the corrected hours.
parentNoCoverBody: Nothing on the schedule for today yet.
declinedTodayHint: Clock in anyway if you're working.

gap.titleOneEscalated_one: {{weekday}} {{start}} – {{end}} starts in {{count}} hour and no one is booked.
gap.titleOneEscalated_other: {{weekday}} {{start}} – {{end}} starts in {{count}} hours and no one is booked.

plan.parentCoveringNanny: Parent is covering {{start}} – {{end}}. Your day starts {{end}} as planned.

setup.title: When do you need care?
setup.body: Add the hours you need someone with your children — then we can tell you when you're covered.

noNeed.title: Nothing needed today
noNeed.body: You haven't set care hours for {{weekday}}s.

nextShift.title: Next shift
nextShift.emptyBody: No shifts in the next two weeks

cover.title: Today's cover
cover.emptyBody: Nothing on the schedule for today yet.

nanny.title: For nannies
nanny.body: This shows a nanny's own schedule. Press and hold to remove it, then add Today's Cover · Parent.

parent.title: For parents
parent.body: This shows the family's side. Press and hold to remove it, then add Next Shift · Nanny.

emptyTitle: You're not in a household yet
emptyDescription: Enter the invite code a family sent you and today's shifts, hours and messages appear here.

needsAttention.title: Needs attention ({{count}})
needsAttention.body: Pending work is waiting on you.

missedHours.sheetHint: Add hours you worked but didn't clock.
missedHours.afterTermsHeadline: Worked before terms were agreed? Add those hours now — they'll be paid at the rate you just agreed.

shiftDetail.withdrawConfirmBody: The other side won't be able to respond once you withdraw.

handoff.tapHintParentEditor: Tap what your nanny should know
handoff.tapHintNannyEditor: Tap what your family should know

discard.cta: I didn't mean to clock in
discard.confirmBody: The clock stops and nothing is counted. It stays on your hours as a crossed-out line, so the record isn't missing anything. You can clock in again straight away.
discard.confirmBodyElapsed: You've been on the clock {{elapsed}}. Discarding it counts as no hours and no pay, and it stays on your hours as a crossed-out line. You can clock in again straight away.

cancelledShift.paid: Your {{start}} – {{end}} shift was cancelled. You'll still be paid for it.
cancelledShift.unpaid: Your {{start}} – {{end}} shift was cancelled — that's {{duration}} off this week's hours.

clockInBlocked.titleNothingSent: Your rate isn't set in Steadily yet
clockInBlocked.bodyFamilySent: {{familyName}} sent you terms on {{date}}. Agree to them and you can clock in straight away.
clockInBlocked.bodyYouSent: You sent your terms on {{date}}. {{familyName}} hasn't answered yet.
clockInBlocked.bodyNothingSent: Neither of you has set a rate in Steadily yet. You can send {{familyName}} your terms, or wait for them to send theirs.
clockInBlocked.footnote: Work today anyway? Keep a note of your hours — you'll be able to add them here once the terms are agreed.

emergencyContactPrompt.title: One more number for {{name}}
emergencyContactPrompt.body: If {{name}} can't reach you and something's happened, who should they call? A partner, a grandparent, a neighbour — anyone who could get here.

nannyJoined.title: {{name}} has joined {{family}}
nannyJoined.bodyAgreed: {{name}} can see the week now. They can clock in from their first shift.
nannyJoined.bodyNothingSent: {{name}} can see the week now. They can clock in once you've both agreed the pay terms.
nannyJoined.bodyYouSent: {{name}} can see the week now. They can clock in as soon as they agree to the terms you sent.
nannyJoined.bodyAgreedNoWeek: {{name}} can see the week now. Nothing's scheduled yet — send them the days and times you need.
nannyJoined.bodyTheySent: {{name}} can see the week now. Their terms are with you, waiting on an answer.

firstClockIn.title: Your first clock-in with the {{family}}!
firstClockIn.body: From here, every hour you work is yours on the record — timed, saved, and there at the end of the week.

firstWeekApproved.title: Your first week — approved!
firstWeekApproved.body: {{household}} approved {{hours}} on {{date}}. Your pay is on the Hours tab.

waitingOnNanny.title: Nobody has used your invite code yet
waitingOnNanny.body: The week stays empty until someone joins with it.
waitingOnNanny.promise: We'll tell you the moment someone joins.
waitingOnNanny.codeA11y: Invite code {{code}}. Opens your invite codes.

membershipEnded.title: {{familyName}} closed their account
membershipEnded.body: Your record of what you worked for them stays here — every shift, every hour, and the weeks that were approved.
membershipEnded.bodyOnClock: You're still on the clock. Clock out when you finish — these are hours you worked, and they stay on your record.
membershipEnded.money: Steadily records pay, it never moves it. Anything still to settle is between you and {{familyName}}.
